text: Svetlana's housewarming is Saturday November 14, new flat in Leith. She said bring nothing but I'll take a plant anyway.
rahul starts at the bank on 11/2, first proper job since the redundancy. bit nervous about the commute

Just off the phone with Dalia. Her mum's hip replacement went ahead yesterday, she's on the ward till Friday at least and already moaning about the food. Dalia's staying with her dad meanwhile so he isn't alone in the house. Need to send her mum a card this week, something funny, not flowers, she hates flowers.
Ming retiring end of March 2027 after 31 years at the council!! party probably the week after
Felix - knee op Dec 3rd. off work six weeks minimum
Tomás got the promotion. Head of logistics from January 4th. Don't forget to send congrats
Dinner at Tariq and Neha's on the 8th, 7:30. Tariq doesn't eat pork, Neha's veggie, so I'm doing the dessert and nothing else
Leon's leaving do was meant to be Thursday but it's been called off, his new start date got pushed back to 12/1 so he's staying on another month.
giulia said her dad's having the scan results on june 3rd, she's pretty anxious about it. check in with her that evening
Zara Ahmed, aka Zee, new in accounts. Into bouldering and has a greyhound called Pepper

Ok so Krisztina is having a dinner thing for her 40th on the 21st, at that Hungarian place on Clerk Street. Partner's called Stefan, he's organising, I need to RSVP to him by Monday. She's been hinting about a new coffee grinder, maybe we could all chip in.

Kofi out of hospital!! home since Tuesday after the bypass. still can't drive for a month and has to do cardiac rehab twice a week at the Western. his son Thabo is driving him for now but goes back to uni on the 9th, so they might need help with lifts after that. offer?
Heather's first day as deputy head was today. Text her tomorrow to see how it went.
Alice and Thomas are hosting a Halloween party October 31, fancy dress mandatory. Thomas wants everyone as film villains apparently.
Nina's gallbladder surgery got cancelled again, third time. She's fed up. Rebooked for 2 February 2027 but she's not holding her breath
call joanna re her mums birthday
Hannah told me at lunch she's handing in her notice. Moving to a startup in Bristol, last day May 14. Hasn't told her manager yet so keep quiet
Thabo's wife Keisha just had her gallbladder out, all fine, discharged this morning. Thabo is doing all the school runs for a while, the twins are seven and apparently loving having dad do it
Chiara 30th 9/19 rooftop bar, plus ones welcome

Bumped into Javier at the station. He said the new job's going well so far, three weeks in, but the hours are brutal and he's barely seeing the kids before bedtime. His partner Rosa is not impressed. He's nervous about his probation review in January because his manager keeps changing what she wants. I should check in with him after Christmas, before the review.
Gabriel's uncle passed away last week. Funeral is in Porto on the 28th and he's flying out Monday. Must message him before he goes
Book MOT before 11/12. Also renew passport, expires March 2027.
Abebe has a new puppy, a beagle called Biscuit. Already chewed through a charger
Ava's going in for her wisdom teeth Thursday. She's terrified of dentists. Maybe drop round with soup Friday
Rosa and her husband are renewing their vows on their 25th anniversary, 6 June 2027, in Sicily. Invite to follow
rebecca got the job!!! senior nurse on the cardiac ward, starts july 7th
Svetlana said Rahul's mum is in hospital again, chest infection. He's been backwards and forwards to Leicester every weekend. Should ring him
Ricardo is a massive F1 fan, Ferrari obviously. Also learning Japanese for a trip next spring
Dinner with Dalia and Ming went late. Ming's thinking of going freelance once the kids are at school. Dalia's brother Leon is getting married next year, date not fixed yet.
Felix said his sister Zara's surgery was a success, the tumour was benign. Huge relief. I should send her something, maybe a book voucher
Note for myself: dentist 2:15 on the 30th, gym induction Nov 4. Nothing else this week
Tomás's leaving lunch Friday at noon, Wagamama. I'm buying the card, everyone sign by Thursday
Tariq mentioned his dad Abebe is retiring in the summer and they're planning a big family party August 15 2026... sorry, 2027. Tariq's doing a speech and is dreading it
Kofi's wife Rebecca is due mid-January. They found out it's a girl. Kofi's already painted the nursery yellow

Giulia started at the architecture firm on Monday. Loves it so far, apparently there's a dog in the office and free lunch on Fridays. She's working on a school extension project already. Her old boss Mr Yilmaz still keeps emailing her questions, which she finds hilarious. We said we'd celebrate properly once she's through the first month, maybe dinner somewhere nice in December.
Remind me to ask Heather how her mum's cataract op went, it was on the 2nd
Neha is coeliac, remember for the dinner party.
Javier Garcia, met him at Krisztina's party. Works in renewables, lives in Portobello, two kids. Into sea swimming and wants someone to go with in the mornings

Just got the invite for Hannah's engagement party, Saturday 12/5, at her parents' place in Harrogate. Her fiancé Gabriel seems lovely, met him once at the pub. Need to book the train before prices go up, and find out if it's a gift thing.
Stefan's hernia op is booked for 21 January 2027. He'll need lifts to and from the hospital, I've already said I'll take him in.

Rosa got made redundant. Last day Friday. She's putting a brave face on it but she's gutted, eleven years there and they told her over a video call. Her husband Tomás is being great about it apparently. She's already got an interview lined up on November 18 with a charity in town, fingers crossed. Take her for a drink next week, and ask about the interview after the 18th.
Thomas - new manager, starts Monday. Seems ok? Ex-army, very punctual
Alice's mum is having a knee replacement next month, Alice is taking two weeks off to look after her. Ask Alice which dates so I can cover her shifts

Krisztina said Ava had her appendix out over the weekend, emergency job, A&E Saturday night then straight into theatre. She's home now, sore but okay. Ava's off work till at least 4/20. Must drop off some meals, and Krisztina says she's bored silly so maybe lend her the box set.
Leon's barbecue moved to Sunday because of rain.
neha said her brother Rahul is moving to Toronto for work in feb, his leaving party is Jan 30th
Ming wants a Kindle for her birthday, she let it slip twice
Grocery shop, pick up prescription, return the parcel to the post office before 6
Chiara's back at work after her surgery, phased return, just mornings until the end of November. Says she's tired but glad to be back.

Voice memo. Um, so Thabo rang, his sister Joanna's been in hospital since Sunday with pneumonia, she's on oxygen but improving. They're hoping she'll be out by the weekend. He sounded exhausted. Don't forget to text him Thursday to see how she is.
Dalia's housewarming 2 November 2026, 4pm onwards. Cat Mochi will be in attendance apparently lol. Bring wine
Heather Johnson retires on March 31st after 22 years teaching. Staff dinner April 2nd, I'm on the organising committee with Keisha
Gabriel passed his driving test second time round!
Abebe's daughter starts uni in Glasgow in September. He's not coping well with the idea
Zara's mum has her pacemaker fitted on the 17th, Zara's super stressed about it. Text Zara on the 16th to wish her mum luck, and then again after

Got invited to Felix's 50th, surprise party at the cricket club, Saturday April 10th. Don't tell him. His wife Svetlana is organising, she says keep the 9th free too for setting up. He loves real ale and old Bond films, could get him the box set. Need to confirm with Svetlana by the end of the month
Tariq's pregnant wife Chiara has terrible morning sickness, off work since last week
Rebecca had her interview at the hospice this morning. Thinks it went well, they'll let her know by Friday.
Kofi and Nina are hosting Christmas dinner this year, 25th obviously, everyone bringing a dish. I'm doing roast potatoes.

Long chat with Ricardo Fernández at the school gates. His father's had a stroke, in the Royal since last Wednesday, speech affected but slowly improving. Ricardo's been sleeping badly and his boss is being difficult about time off. He's got a meeting with HR on 11/3 about compassionate leave. Rosa, his wife, is managing the kids. Must call him after the HR meeting to see how it went, and maybe offer to do pickups on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
